styleHint: STYLE: classic Mac OS 9 desktop icon, 3/4 isometric perspective, chunky soft-3D rendering with hard silhouette. PALETTE: deep purple (#1a0524) and black base, hot magenta (#ff2bd6) primary, electric cyan (#3df0ff) and lime (#aaff3d) accents, occasional bone white highlights. TEXTURE: subtle CRT scanline overlay, faint magenta bloom on bright pixels, 1-bit ordered dithering in shadows and gradients, slight RGB channel split on edges. RIM: thin 1-pixel neon magenta outline glow around the silhouette. CYPHERPUNK FLAVOR: feels like a retrofuture terminal-era operating system mascot — early-internet, BBS, vaporwave Y2K cyberdelic. Transparent background. Single icon, centered, no label, no caption, no border, no shadow plate.
bootstrapPrompt: A chunky 3D folder icon, Mac OS 9 manila-folder shape but recolored in deep purple and black with a hot magenta tab, slightly open showing a pink interior, edges glowing magenta.
